changeSet.author: yambo
changeSet.sql: UPDATE family_product fp SET profile_id = ( SELECT MIN(fpp.profile_id) FROM family_product_profile fpp WHERE fpp.family_product_id = fp.id )

WITH canonical AS ( SELECT profile_id, MIN(id) AS keep_id FROM family_product WHERE profile_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY profile_id ) UPDATE product p SET family_product_id = c.keep_id FROM family_product fp JOIN canonical c ON c.profile_id = fp.profile_id WHERE p.family_product_id = fp.id AND p.family_product_id <> c.keep_id

WITH canonical AS ( SELECT profile_id, MIN(id) AS keep_id FROM family_product WHERE profile_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY profile_id ) UPDATE family_product_project fpproj SET family_product_id = c.keep_id FROM family_product fp JOIN canonical c ON c.profile_id = fp.profile_id WHERE fpproj.family_product_id = fp.id AND fpproj.family_product_id <> c.keep_id

WITH canonical AS ( SELECT profile_id, MIN(id) AS keep_id FROM family_product WHERE profile_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY profile_id ) UPDATE promotion_invitation_family_product pifp SET family_product_id = c.keep_id FROM family_product fp JOIN canonical c ON c.profile_id = fp.profile_id WHERE pifp.family_product_id = fp.id AND pifp.family_product_id <> c.keep_id

WITH canonical AS ( SELECT profile_id, MIN(id) AS keep_id FROM family_product WHERE profile_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY profile_id ) DELETE FROM family_product fp USING canonical c WHERE fp.profile_id = c.profile_id AND fp.id <> c.keep_id
